d: A sales qualification checklist of six facts about the buyer: Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Identify Pain and Champion. Missing facts mean the deal is not yet qualified.
A sales method of seven steps the seller works through in order: Rapport, Upfront Contract, Pain, Budget, Decision, Fulfillment and Postsell.
A normalized share of positive average-score differences between won and lost deals, within one framework. It is descriptive and exploratory, not a causal effect or win-probability estimate.

One 0–10 score per skill per deal, merging the call score and the email score (each 0–5): (1 − (1 − call ÷ 5) × (1 − email ÷ 5)) × 10. When both sources show the skill, the deal scores higher than either alone.
Customer relationship management system: where deals, their stage, owner and close date are recorded.
Deals won as a share of all closed deals (won plus lost).
The one next step the AI wrote for the rep on each call and skill: what to do differently next time.
The one table every stage reads and writes: one row per deal from the CRM plus one row per recorded call, keyed on deal ID + call date.
The mean of every rep's score on a skill. The dark tick on each bar in Rep Coaching marks it.
